s:
Dřevo vhodné na táborák.\n
		Pomáhá udržet teplo v noci a poskytuje možnost vařit jídlo.\n \n
		%c[0,255,255,255]VLASTNOSTI:\n
		%c[d_orange] - %c[ui_gray_2] použitelné k rozdělávání ohně".
		%c[d_orange] - %c[ui_gray_2] kliknutí pravým tlačítkem myši na sekeru v blízkosti stromu > 'sekat dřevo'		
		%c[d_cyan] - %c[ui_gray_2] lze nasekat sekerou

Although it is easy to find wood in the Zone, but high-quality firewood suitable for a campfire is a rarity. Despite of being rare it is very cheap, but also heavy. It can become an essential thing for hiking and raids. Helps to keep warm at night and gives the opportunity to cook food.
